own_solution.law: Static equilibrium: vertical N = (m+M) g; torques about foot give wall force N_w = g cot(theta) (m/2 + M f); friction F = N_w; ground force = sqrt(N^2 + F^2).
assumptions: uniform ladder, centre of mass at midpoint

notes: N = 82*9.8 = 803.6 N; N_w = 9.8*(6 + 42)*cot62 = 470.4*0.53171 = 250.12 N; |F_ground| = sqrt(803.6^2 + 250.12^2) = sqrt(708331) = 841.62 N. At 44 deg: N_w = 470.4*1.03553 = 487.11 N; |F| = sqrt(645773 + 237279) = 939.71 N (needs mu >= 0.61; non-slipping is stated). Length cancels from the torque balance. The earlier-experiment tilt leaves no state since the stated angle is the angle at the outset of this experiment.
